tools.name: ads_whoami
tools.description: Show which Ads Uploader user this session is authenticated as (email, name, user ID) and the API host it talks to. Use this to verify the tool session matches the account the user is logged into on the web before editing builds or creating ads.

tools.name: ads_list_accounts
tools.description: List Meta ad accounts available to the authenticated Ads Uploader user. Use refresh to re-check Meta for reinstated/changed accounts (rate limited).

refresh.description: Re-check Meta for reinstated/changed accounts (rate limited).

tools.name: ads_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns in an ad account, optionally filtered by name search and status.

fields.description: Optional output columns; id is always included, and unavailable status values are null.

status.description: 'active' returns only active/in-process campaigns (default); 'all' also includes paused and archived.

tools.name: ads_list_adsets

status.description: 'active' returns only active/in-process ad sets (default); 'all' also includes paused and archived.

fields.description: Optional output columns; id is always included, and unavailable status values are null.

status.description: 'active' returns only active/in-process ads (default); 'all' also includes paused and archived.

tools.name: ads_get_ad

tools.name: ads_list_pages
tools.description: List Facebook Pages (with their connected Instagram accounts) available for profile overrides in an ad account.

tools.name: ads_search_targeting
tools.description: Search Meta targeting values for ads_create or a saved build spec. Use type=city to find targeting.cities[].key values, type=zip to find targeting.zips[].key values, or type=detailed to find complete {id,name,type} entries for targeting.detailedTargetingGroups. IDs must never be guessed; use this tool to discover them.

query.description: City name, zip/postal code, or detailed-targeting keyword to search.

type.description: Use city to find targeting.cities[].key values, zip to find targeting.zips[].key values, or detailed to find detailedTargetingGroups selections.

tools.name: ads_list_presets
tools.description: List saved API or ad text presets for an ad account.

tools.name: ads_get_preset
tools.description: Get one saved preset by ID.

tools.name: ads_save_preset
tools.description: Save an existing ad as a reusable API preset.

fromAdId.description: Existing Meta ad ID to save as a preset.

tools.name: ads_list_builds
tools.description: List saved uploader builds for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by ad account.

accountId.description: Optional ad account ID filter, e.g. act_123.

tools.name: ads_save_build
tools.description: Create a durable saved build for the authenticated user. A spec-only build is supported and preferred for agent-created configurations because the web uploader hydrates it and generates its own webState on resume. Portable specs support the full v1 launch surface, including campaign-qualified texts.perAdset entries and per-campaign profile.campaigns identity overrides. Web-captured builds can launch without uploadId when spec.mediaItems carries a mediaHash for every image and mediaId for every video, plus thumbnailHash for video paths that require it (Multi Media uses thumbnailUrl). Do not construct webState by hand. Only provide webState when round-tripping a webState previously read from a build without changing its structure. accountId is optional when it can be derived from webState.selectedAccount.accountId, webState.selectedAccount.account_id, or spec.accountId. Confirm that the build was saved. If the user has an open uploader tab, do not repeat the returned url; share it only when the user asks for it or says the tab is closed. For a new headless build with no open uploader tab, give the returned url so the user can open and review it. Use ads_create with buildId to launch it when spec.launchable is true. launchable only describes headless ads_create launches; a launchable:false build still opens and can be edited in the web uploader. Unresolved video identifiers must be repaired before launch. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. Canonical 4x5 primary with linked 9x16 item: {"mediaName":"X__H01.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1805649190475379","thumbnailHash":"PRIMARY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"portrait","isGroupPrimary":true,"assetGroupId":"ag_1","linkedAssets":[{"mediaName":"X__H01-9x16.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1234567890","thumbnailHash":"STORY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"story"}]}

accountId.description: Optional ad account ID. The server can also derive it from webState.selectedAccount.accountId, webState.selectedAccount.account_id, or spec.accountId.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes stored on the build.

spec.description: Portable launch specification. Spec-only creation is supported and preferred for agent-created builds.

webState.description: Opaque web uploader session snapshot. Do not construct it by hand. Only provide webState when round-tripping a snapshot previously read from a build without changing its structure.

tools.name: ads_get_build
tools.description: Get one saved build by ID. Returns spec and webState without truncation. Update spec for content changes. Treat webState as an opaque web uploader session snapshot and do not reconstruct it. Other metadata is trimmed for display.

tools.name: ads_fork_build
tools.description: Fork a saved build into a new autosaved draft. Use this instead of editing the existing build when the user wants a variant and the original must stay intact. The fork copies the uploader configuration and media references, receives a new build ID, and can be edited independently. Confirm that the fork was created; share its URL only when the user asks for it or says there is no open uploader tab.

buildId.description: Saved build ID to duplicate, e.g. build_abc123...

tools.name: ads_update_build
tools.description: Update one saved build by ID: rename it, edit notes, patch its portable spec, or deliberately replace its full spec/webState. Uploaded-media partnerships support profile.partnership for a shared Second Identity and texts.perAd/perAdset sponsor overrides, including both IDs null for No Partner. These builds launch through the CLI and MCP and hydrate their identities in the web uploader. Approval is rechecked at preview and launch. Prefer specPatch for content edits: omitted fields survive and nested text entries merge field-by-field, so changing headlines does not clear link, displayUrl, CTA, URL tags, or AI disclosure. Uploaded-media texts.perAd keys are file names, or media:<id> to target one upload when two share a name. CTA fields use Meta enum values such as SHOP_NOW. Standard ads normalize human labels such as Shop Now; imported partnership posts require the enum and do not normalize labels. specPatch requires the revision from ads_get_build as expectedRevision. Use spec only for a full rewrite because it replaces the whole portable spec. Do not construct webState by hand; only round-trip an unchanged webState previously read from the build. When only portable spec changes, the web uploader regenerates webState on next resume. Setting a name promotes an autosaved build to a kept, named build. Returns updated metadata only; call ads_get_build again to read the stored state. Confirm that the update was saved; an open uploader tab picks it up automatically. Share the build url only when the user asks for it or says the tab is closed. Do not surface webStateStale or launchable/launchBlockers unless the user asked about launching from the CLI/MCP: webStateStale:true after a spec edit is normal and clears itself when the web uploader next opens the build, and launchable only describes headless ads_create launches - it never prevents opening, editing, or launching the build in the web uploader.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by ads_get_build. Required with specPatch and recommended for every update; the update fails instead of overwriting a newer revision.

name.description: New build name. Setting a name marks the build as manually saved, so it stops rotating out with autosaves.

notes.description: Free-form notes stored on the build.

spec.description: Replacement portable spec (the launch configuration used by ads_create with buildId). Send the FULL updated spec object, not a partial diff. Set to null to clear it.

specPatch.description: Preferred for content edits. Field-aware merge patch applied to the stored portable spec: omitted fields survive, nested objects (including individual texts.perAd/perAdset entries) merge, supplied arrays replace, and null removes a field. Requires expectedRevision. Computed launchability metadata cannot be patched.

webState.description: Opaque web uploader session snapshot. Do not construct this object by hand. Only send it when round-tripping a webState previously read from the build without changing its structure. For content changes, update spec only; the web uploader regenerates webState on its next resume.

tools.name: ads_delete_build
tools.description: Delete one saved build by ID.

tools.name: ads_list_uploads

tools.name: ads_get_upload
tools.description: Get a completed upload batch by batchId, or poll a background media-ingest job by jobId until complete is true.

accountId.description: Optional ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

jobId.description: Background ingest job ID. Poll until complete is true; the final batch summary is returned in result.

tools.name: ads_upload
tools.description: Upload media to an ad account. Use paths for local disk media, files[].url for public URLs or Google Drive file links, or driveFolderUrl for a public Drive folder. URL and Drive modes return a background jobId to poll with ads_get_upload. Base64 is only for a couple of small images; presigned mode is only for byte-capable environments.

batchId.description: Optional existing batch ID for grouping with an earlier upload.

driveFolderUrl.description: Public Google Drive folder share link for server-side background ingestion.

paths.description: Local files or directories to upload when running the local stdio server. Relative paths resolve from cwd.

files.description: Public media URLs (including Drive file links), small inline images, or presigned metadata.

url.description: Public HTTPS media URL. Google Drive links are detected automatically.

name.description: Required for base64 or presigned mode. Not accepted with url — the filename always comes from the remote source.

contentType.description: Media MIME type such as image/jpeg or video/mp4.

base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes for a couple of small images only.

size.description: Optional declared URL size; required for presigned mode.

thumbnailFor.description: Video filename this thumbnail should attach to. If omitted, *_thumbnail names are matched automatically.

presigned.description: Only for environments that can PUT bytes themselves. Large files may return multipart part URLs.

cwd.description: Optional base directory for resolving relative paths.

tools.name: ads_upload_finalize
tools.description: Finalize a presigned upload batch after the client has PUT each file. Hosted calls return a background ingest jobId; poll it with ads_get_upload.

batchId.description: Upload batch ID returned by ads_upload with presigned=true.

files.description: Files returned by ads_upload presigned mode after the client has PUT each file to uploadUrl or each multipart chunk to parts[].url.

thumbnailFileKey.description: For videos, staged fileKey of the custom thumbnail image to attach.

isThumbnail.description: True when this uploaded image is only a custom thumbnail and should not become standalone media.

thumbnailForFileKey.description: For thumbnail images, the video fileKey this thumbnail belongs to.

thumbnailForName.description: For thumbnail images, the video filename this thumbnail belongs to.

uploadUrl.description: Single-PUT upload URL, present for files at or below the multipart threshold.

uploadId.description: Multipart upload ID, present for files above the multipart threshold.

parts.description: Multipart part upload URLs returned by ads_upload. The finalize call does not need ETags.

thumbnailMap.description: Optional explicit video-to-thumbnail staged key map. ads_upload usually returns thumbnailFileKey on the video automatically.

tools.name: ads_create
tools.description: Create ads from a v1 AdSpec request body or saved build. New campaigns/ad sets with lifetime budgets are rejected with HTTP 400 and a LIFETIME_BUDGET_END_* code unless the effective end is at least 24 hours after the start. Set options.schedule.endTime or use a daily budget. Existing ad set end-date warnings are non-blocking. Supports Instagram existing-post partnership ads with common, per-ad-set, or per-ad sponsors and text. Import by Instagram URL, shortcode, source ID, or ad code in mediaItems. Uploaded media supports Facebook and Instagram partnerships: set profile.partnership.enabled, shared or campaign sponsors, and texts.perAd/perAdset sponsors. Null both row sponsor IDs means No Partner; sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount supports Instagram-only partners. Approval is checked for the effective First Identity. Omit uploaderMode for uploads. Facebook post imports, mixed post/upload batches and Threads on imported posts are unsupported. Uploaded-media texts.perAd keys are file names, or media:<id> to target one upload when two share a name. CTA fields use Meta enum values such as SHOP_NOW. Standard ads normalize human labels such as Shop Now; imported partnership posts require the enum and do not normalize labels. Saved builds use their upload batch first, then fall back by media name to account-scoped mediaHash/image and mediaId/video identifiers captured in mediaItems. Videos used as standard, carousel, flexible, or placement media also require captured thumbnailHash; Multi Media videos require captured thumbnailUrl. Supports campaign-qualified texts.perAdset overrides and per-campaign profile.campaigns identities in multi-campaign launches. Admin-only options.testMode runs Meta validate_only without creating Meta objects and returns metaValidation passed, failed and not-checked counts. This blocks until the server job completes or the 30 minute ceiling is reached. If it returns status "still_running", the job is still progressing server-side; call ads_get_job with the returned jobId until complete is true. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. buildId.description: Saved build ID. When provided, the build's portable spec is used as the create body.

uploadId.description: Upload batch ID returned by ads_upload or ads_get_upload.

adPresetId.description: Saved API preset ID. Mutually exclusive with campaign, adSet, and copyFromAd.

textPresetId.description: Saved text preset ID. Mutually exclusive with texts.

copyFromAd.description: Existing Meta ad ID to copy settings from.

adNames.description: Exact ad names keyed by mediaName. Overrides mediaItems[].customName and adNamePattern. Blank values clear an override; all other whitespace and tokens are literal.

resetAdNameIndexPerAdSet.description: Restart the {index} token for ad names in each ad set.

carousel.description: Carousel creatives using media names from uploadId or captured mediaItems. Card text stays in the public AdSpec shape.

flexible.description: Flexible-format creatives using media names from uploadId or captured mediaItems.

multimedia.description: Multi Media creatives with optional per-asset public text fields.

mediaItems.description: Portable saved-build media metadata. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. When uploadId is unavailable or incomplete, images resolve by mediaHash and videos by mediaId. Standard, carousel, flexible, and placement videos also need thumbnailHash because the current creative pipeline requires it; Multi Media videos use their captured thumbnailUrl. Facebook identifiers are account-bound, so accountId must match the account captured with the media. Alternatively use Instagram existing-post partnership rows; posts and uploaded media cannot be mixed. Import by Instagram URL, shortcode, source ID, or ad code. Facebook post imports remain unsupported.

targeting.description: AdSpec-shaped audience override for NEW ad sets: locations, optional age/gender, and one flat OR group of mixed detailed-targeting selections. Omitted fields inherit from the source ad set. Set detailedTargetingSelected=true with an empty detailedTargetingGroups array to clear inherited detailed targeting. Raw Meta flexible_spec is not accepted.

key.description: Meta city key from geo search.

name.description: Display name returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

region.description: Display region returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

countryCode.description: Display country code returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

zips.description: Zip/postal codes to target, alongside or instead of cities. Find keys with targeting search type=zip.

key.description: Meta zip key from zip targeting search, e.g. "US:90210".

name.description: Display name returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

region.description: Display region returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

countryCode.description: Display country code returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

interestGroups.description: Legacy version-3 interest-only groups. Accepted so saved builds written before mixed detailed targeting continue to launch.

path.description: Optional display-only category path; stripped before the Meta payload.

detailedTargetingGroups.description: Detailed-targeting groups in AdSpec form. Phase 1 supports one OR group. Each selection's type becomes its flexible_spec key; the outer array is reserved for future AND groups.

type.description: Meta detailed-targeting type, such as interests, work_employers, or an unknown future flexible_spec key.

audienceSizeLower.description: Display-only lower audience-size estimate returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

audienceSizeUpper.description: Display-only upper audience-size estimate returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

value.description: Original primitive Meta value for detailed-targeting types that do not use id/name objects. Preserved exactly in flexible_spec.

path.description: Optional display-only category path; stripped before the Meta payload.

selectionVersion.description: Selection-metadata version. Version 4 is required for mixed detailed targeting; version 3 remains accepted for interest-only saved builds and version 2 for legacy age/gender builds. Does not reach Meta.

ageSelected.description: Whether the web UI age control was explicitly selected. Concrete age fields remain the payload authority.

genderSelected.description: Whether the web UI gender control was explicitly selected. The genders field remains the payload authority.

detailedTargetingSelected.description: Whether detailed targeting is explicitly overridden. False or omitted inherits the source; true with an empty detailedTargetingGroups array clears inherited detailed targeting.

launchable.description: Saved-build metadata. Ignored when creating ads.

launchBlockers.description: Saved-build metadata. Ignored when creating ads.

callToAction.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

cta.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.
Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

dailyBudget.description: Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) daily budget in whole currency units, e.g. 100 for $100. Mutually exclusive with lifetimeBudget and with ad-set budgets. Omit to inherit the source campaign's budget.

lifetimeBudget.description: CBO lifetime budget in whole currency units. Mutually exclusive with dailyBudget and with ad-set budgets. Omit to inherit the source campaign's budget.

campaigns.description: Campaign names may repeat. IDs are optional; supply unique IDs to address per-campaign profile overrides when names repeat.

names.description: Exact names for new ad sets, keyed by the JSON tuple [campaignKey, targetingKey, urlVariantKey or label]. Campaign keys use the campaign ID or campaign-index-N (1-based) for id-less multi-campaign entries; single-campaign plans use the name. Legacy name-based tuples still load. Applied after text resolution; texts.perAdset continues to use template names.

minimumRoas.description: Minimum return-on-ad-spend goal as a ratio, e.g. 1.5 for 1.5x. Used by LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS and stored by Meta as bid_constraints.roas_average_floor.

minSpend.description: Minimum spend for this ad set under a CBO campaign, in whole currency units. Positive values require a campaign dailyBudget/lifetimeBudget in this request. Pass 0 to remove the minimum the source ad set carries. Mutually exclusive with minSpendPercentage.

maxSpend.description: Maximum spend (cap) for this ad set under a CBO campaign, in whole currency units. Positive values require a campaign dailyBudget/lifetimeBudget in this request. Pass 0 to remove the cap the source ad set carries. Mutually exclusive with maxSpendPercentage.

minSpendPercentage.description: Minimum spend for this ad set as a percentage of the CBO campaign budget (25 = 25%). Multiples of 5 only, matching Ads Manager. Also valid when the destination campaign is an existing CBO campaign. Meta only keeps percentage semantics when BOTH minSpendPercentage and maxSpendPercentage are set; a lone side is applied as its absolute equivalent. Mutually exclusive with minSpend.

maxSpendPercentage.description: Maximum spend for this ad set as a percentage of the CBO campaign budget (25 = 25%). Multiples of 5 only, matching Ads Manager. Also valid when the destination campaign is an existing CBO campaign. Meta only keeps percentage semantics when BOTH minSpendPercentage and maxSpendPercentage are set; a lone side is applied as its absolute equivalent. Mutually exclusive with maxSpend.

targeting.description: Custom-mode-only audience override for this ad set. Fields resolve after build-level targeting and before the source ad set; a matching adSet.targetingPerAdSet entry takes precedence.

media.description: Canonical mediaName references for this group; one post may appear in several groups.

targetingPerAdSet.description: Per-ad-set audience overrides allowed in any ad-set mode. Keys are final planned ad-set names or IDs, or collision-safe campaign::name / campaign::ID keys for multi-campaign builds. Matching entries take precedence over adSet.groups[].targeting, then build-level targeting, then the source ad set.

perAdset.description: Per-ad-set text keyed by ad set name/ID or collision-safe campaign::key. Each key MUST exactly equal a FINAL planned ad-set name/ID — note ad-set names are often generated at create time (e.g. 'Ad Set 01') so a descriptive key that does not match the planned name will not resolve. For one-ad-per-ad-set builds prefer texts.perAd keyed by filename (robust shape); use perAdset only for ad sets that genuinely hold multiple ads.

perAd.description: Per-ad text keys are file names, or media:<id> to target one upload when two share a name. Imported posts allow one headline, optional text, and effective sponsor IDs; omitted fields inherit.

perAdSet.description: Compatibility alias for canonical texts.perAdset. Conflicting duplicate definitions are rejected.

partnership.description: Legacy uploader imported-post texts. Do not combine with canonical common/perAdset/perAd/mode.

pageId.description: Facebook Page override for this ad or ad set. Omit to inherit.

instagramId.description: Instagram account override for this ad or ad set. Null removes it; omit to inherit.

threadsId.description: Threads profile override for this ad or ad set. Null removes it; omit to inherit.

cta.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

callToAction.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

sponsorPageId.description: Second Identity Facebook Page ID. Omitted inherits. With sponsorInstagramId also null, removes the partner for this uploaded-media scope. Imported posts require an effective brand Page.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Second Identity Instagram account ID. Omitted inherits; null removes this ID. Both sponsor IDs null means No Partner for uploaded media.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses the Instagram account as Second Identity without a Facebook Page. Requires an effective sponsorInstagramId.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

type.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

partnership.description: Partnerships using your own uploaded media on Facebook and Instagram, or existing Instagram posts. Choose the shared Second Identity and launch-wide header mode. Facebook post imports remain unsupported.

enabled.description: Set true for uploaded-media partnerships. Uploaded media uses ordinary assembly with the Second Identity. Imported posts always require partnership enabled.

pageUseInstagramAccount.description: Compatibility field; has no effect on the imported-post path. Creator identity is resolved from the post.

sponsorPageId.description: Shared Second Identity Facebook Page for uploaded media, or authorizing brand Page for imported Instagram posts. Per-campaign and active per-row values override this.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses an Instagram-only Second Identity, omitting its Facebook Page. Requires sponsorInstagramId. False or omitted for imported posts.

sponsorUseInstagramAccount.description: Legacy saved-build alias for sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount. Must be false or omitted for imported posts.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Optional shared Second Identity Instagram account for uploaded media, or brand Instagram account for imported posts.

displayMode.description: Launch-wide header mode: both (ad_format 1), first (2, creator-only for imported posts, labelled Partner identity only), or dynamic (3). Defaults to both.

sourceInstagramMediaId.description: Legacy shared-source assertion. Prefer mediaItems[].sourceInstagramMediaId; if supplied here, it must match the single imported row.

sourceFacebookPostId.description: Legacy field; a nonempty value is rejected for headless Facebook imports.

uploaderMode.description: True selects existing-post import and is rejected with uploaded media. Omit or set false for uploaded-media partnerships.

useFacebookPage.description: Use the Facebook Page as the Instagram identity for Pages with no linked Instagram account. Cannot be combined with instagramId.

campaigns.description: Per-campaign Page, Instagram, and Threads overrides keyed by campaign ID or unambiguous campaign name from campaign.campaigns.

useFacebookPage.description: Use the Facebook Page as the Instagram identity for Pages with no linked Instagram account. Cannot be combined with instagramId.

sponsorPageId.description: Second Identity Facebook Page ID. Omitted inherits. With sponsorInstagramId also null, removes the partner for this uploaded-media scope. Imported posts require an effective brand Page.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Second Identity Instagram account ID. Omitted inherits; null removes this ID. Both sponsor IDs null means No Partner for uploaded media.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses the Instagram account as Second Identity without a Facebook Page. Requires an effective sponsorInstagramId.

testMode.description: Admin-only. Assemble payloads and validate eligible calls through Meta validate_only without creating Meta objects. Returns metaValidation passed/failed/not-checked results; may store launch records and encrypted verified partnership codes.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

partnershipCreator.description: Optional expected creator identity, verified against Meta. It cannot replace the post owner or grant permission.

partnershipAdEligibility.description: Meta ad-eligibility verdict for the partnership post, used for the licensed-music warning. Null or UNKNOWN means Meta did not say.

sourceFacebookPostId.description: Legacy empty web field only. Facebook headless imports are not supported.

_id.description: Stable captured media identity, retained when resuming a saved build.

customName.description: Exact ad name. Nonblank values preserve spaces and literal tokens with NFC normalization only; blank clears the panel rename.

cta.description: Meta CTA enum, for example SHOP_NOW, or empty string. Human labels such as Shop Now are not normalized on the partnership path. Nonempty CTA requires an http(s) link.

callToAction.description: Meta CTA enum, for example SHOP_NOW, or empty string. Human labels such as Shop Now are not normalized on the partnership path. Nonempty CTA requires an http(s) link.

multiAdvertiserAds.description: Whether to allow multi-advertiser ads; defaults to true when omitted and not inherited.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

common.description: Shared imported-post text. Set shared sponsor fields in profile.partnership; put adCode in import or the active perAd/perAdset scope, never common.

tools.name: ads_preview
tools.description: Preview a v1 AdSpec or saved build, including uploaded-media partnerships and Instagram existing-post partnership imports. Uploaded-media previews report effective sponsors, approval and header mode per ad and ad set. Resolves posts and checks Meta permissions using read/validate-only calls without creating ads or storing codes. Returns per-ad creators, sponsors, optional text, authorization status, and a code-free resolvedSpec. Always returns warnings, which may include lifetime budget end-date codes, and lifetimeBudget when a lifetime budget applies. For new campaigns/ad sets, lifetime end-date warnings have blocking: true and create rejects them with HTTP 400. Set options.schedule.endTime at least 24 hours after the start or use a daily budget. Existing ad set warnings stay non-blocking; extend their end dates in Ads Manager. Supply transient codes again at create. Uploaded media supports Facebook and Instagram partnerships: set profile.partnership.enabled, shared or campaign sponsors, and texts.perAd/perAdset sponsors. Null both row sponsor IDs means No Partner; sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount supports Instagram-only partners. Approval is checked for the effective First Identity. Omit uploaderMode for uploads. Facebook post imports, mixed post/upload batches and Threads on imported posts are unsupported. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. buildId.description: Saved build ID. When provided, the build's portable spec is used as the create body.

uploadId.description: Upload batch ID returned by ads_upload or ads_get_upload.

adPresetId.description: Saved API preset ID. Mutually exclusive with campaign, adSet, and copyFromAd.

textPresetId.description: Saved text preset ID. Mutually exclusive with texts.

copyFromAd.description: Existing Meta ad ID to copy settings from.

adNames.description: Exact ad names keyed by mediaName. Overrides mediaItems[].customName and adNamePattern. Blank values clear an override; all other whitespace and tokens are literal.

resetAdNameIndexPerAdSet.description: Restart the {index} token for ad names in each ad set.

carousel.description: Carousel creatives using media names from uploadId or captured mediaItems. Card text stays in the public AdSpec shape.

flexible.description: Flexible-format creatives using media names from uploadId or captured mediaItems.

multimedia.description: Multi Media creatives with optional per-asset public text fields.

mediaItems.description: Portable saved-build media metadata. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. When uploadId is unavailable or incomplete, images resolve by mediaHash and videos by mediaId. Standard, carousel, flexible, and placement videos also need thumbnailHash because the current creative pipeline requires it; Multi Media videos use their captured thumbnailUrl. Facebook identifiers are account-bound, so accountId must match the account captured with the media. Alternatively use Instagram existing-post partnership rows; posts and uploaded media cannot be mixed. Import by Instagram URL, shortcode, source ID, or ad code. Facebook post imports remain unsupported.

targeting.description: AdSpec-shaped audience override for NEW ad sets: locations, optional age/gender, and one flat OR group of mixed detailed-targeting selections. Omitted fields inherit from the source ad set. Set detailedTargetingSelected=true with an empty detailedTargetingGroups array to clear inherited detailed targeting. Raw Meta flexible_spec is not accepted.

key.description: Meta city key from geo search.

name.description: Display name returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

region.description: Display region returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

countryCode.description: Display country code returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

zips.description: Zip/postal codes to target, alongside or instead of cities. Find keys with targeting search type=zip.

key.description: Meta zip key from zip targeting search, e.g. "US:90210".

name.description: Display name returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

region.description: Display region returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

countryCode.description: Display country code returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

interestGroups.description: Legacy version-3 interest-only groups. Accepted so saved builds written before mixed detailed targeting continue to launch.

path.description: Optional display-only category path; stripped before the Meta payload.

detailedTargetingGroups.description: Detailed-targeting groups in AdSpec form. Phase 1 supports one OR group. Each selection's type becomes its flexible_spec key; the outer array is reserved for future AND groups.

type.description: Meta detailed-targeting type, such as interests, work_employers, or an unknown future flexible_spec key.

audienceSizeLower.description: Display-only lower audience-size estimate returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

audienceSizeUpper.description: Display-only upper audience-size estimate returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

value.description: Original primitive Meta value for detailed-targeting types that do not use id/name objects. Preserved exactly in flexible_spec.

path.description: Optional display-only category path; stripped before the Meta payload.

selectionVersion.description: Selection-metadata version. Version 4 is required for mixed detailed targeting; version 3 remains accepted for interest-only saved builds and version 2 for legacy age/gender builds. Does not reach Meta.

ageSelected.description: Whether the web UI age control was explicitly selected. Concrete age fields remain the payload authority.

genderSelected.description: Whether the web UI gender control was explicitly selected. The genders field remains the payload authority.

detailedTargetingSelected.description: Whether detailed targeting is explicitly overridden. False or omitted inherits the source; true with an empty detailedTargetingGroups array clears inherited detailed targeting.

launchable.description: Saved-build metadata. Ignored when creating ads.

launchBlockers.description: Saved-build metadata. Ignored when creating ads.

callToAction.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

cta.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.
Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

dailyBudget.description: Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) daily budget in whole currency units, e.g. 100 for $100. Mutually exclusive with lifetimeBudget and with ad-set budgets. Omit to inherit the source campaign's budget.

lifetimeBudget.description: CBO lifetime budget in whole currency units. Mutually exclusive with dailyBudget and with ad-set budgets. Omit to inherit the source campaign's budget.

campaigns.description: Campaign names may repeat. IDs are optional; supply unique IDs to address per-campaign profile overrides when names repeat.

names.description: Exact names for new ad sets, keyed by the JSON tuple [campaignKey, targetingKey, urlVariantKey or label]. Campaign keys use the campaign ID or campaign-index-N (1-based) for id-less multi-campaign entries; single-campaign plans use the name. Legacy name-based tuples still load. Applied after text resolution; texts.perAdset continues to use template names.

minimumRoas.description: Minimum return-on-ad-spend goal as a ratio, e.g. 1.5 for 1.5x. Used by LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS and stored by Meta as bid_constraints.roas_average_floor.

minSpend.description: Minimum spend for this ad set under a CBO campaign, in whole currency units. Positive values require a campaign dailyBudget/lifetimeBudget in this request. Pass 0 to remove the minimum the source ad set carries. Mutually exclusive with minSpendPercentage.

maxSpend.description: Maximum spend (cap) for this ad set under a CBO campaign, in whole currency units. Positive values require a campaign dailyBudget/lifetimeBudget in this request. Pass 0 to remove the cap the source ad set carries. Mutually exclusive with maxSpendPercentage.

minSpendPercentage.description: Minimum spend for this ad set as a percentage of the CBO campaign budget (25 = 25%). Multiples of 5 only, matching Ads Manager. Also valid when the destination campaign is an existing CBO campaign. Meta only keeps percentage semantics when BOTH minSpendPercentage and maxSpendPercentage are set; a lone side is applied as its absolute equivalent. Mutually exclusive with minSpend.

maxSpendPercentage.description: Maximum spend for this ad set as a percentage of the CBO campaign budget (25 = 25%). Multiples of 5 only, matching Ads Manager. Also valid when the destination campaign is an existing CBO campaign. Meta only keeps percentage semantics when BOTH minSpendPercentage and maxSpendPercentage are set; a lone side is applied as its absolute equivalent. Mutually exclusive with maxSpend.

targeting.description: Custom-mode-only audience override for this ad set. Fields resolve after build-level targeting and before the source ad set; a matching adSet.targetingPerAdSet entry takes precedence.

media.description: Canonical mediaName references for this group; one post may appear in several groups.

targetingPerAdSet.description: Per-ad-set audience overrides allowed in any ad-set mode. Keys are final planned ad-set names or IDs, or collision-safe campaign::name / campaign::ID keys for multi-campaign builds. Matching entries take precedence over adSet.groups[].targeting, then build-level targeting, then the source ad set.

perAdset.description: Per-ad-set text keyed by ad set name/ID or collision-safe campaign::key. Each key MUST exactly equal a FINAL planned ad-set name/ID — note ad-set names are often generated at create time (e.g. 'Ad Set 01') so a descriptive key that does not match the planned name will not resolve. For one-ad-per-ad-set builds prefer texts.perAd keyed by filename (robust shape); use perAdset only for ad sets that genuinely hold multiple ads.

perAd.description: Per-ad text keys are file names, or media:<id> to target one upload when two share a name. Imported posts allow one headline, optional text, and effective sponsor IDs; omitted fields inherit.

perAdSet.description: Compatibility alias for canonical texts.perAdset. Conflicting duplicate definitions are rejected.

partnership.description: Legacy uploader imported-post texts. Do not combine with canonical common/perAdset/perAd/mode.

pageId.description: Facebook Page override for this ad or ad set. Omit to inherit.

instagramId.description: Instagram account override for this ad or ad set. Null removes it; omit to inherit.

threadsId.description: Threads profile override for this ad or ad set. Null removes it; omit to inherit.

cta.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

callToAction.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

sponsorPageId.description: Second Identity Facebook Page ID. Omitted inherits. With sponsorInstagramId also null, removes the partner for this uploaded-media scope. Imported posts require an effective brand Page.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Second Identity Instagram account ID. Omitted inherits; null removes this ID. Both sponsor IDs null means No Partner for uploaded media.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses the Instagram account as Second Identity without a Facebook Page. Requires an effective sponsorInstagramId.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

type.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

partnership.description: Partnerships using your own uploaded media on Facebook and Instagram, or existing Instagram posts. Choose the shared Second Identity and launch-wide header mode. Facebook post imports remain unsupported.

enabled.description: Set true for uploaded-media partnerships. Uploaded media uses ordinary assembly with the Second Identity. Imported posts always require partnership enabled.

pageUseInstagramAccount.description: Compatibility field; has no effect on the imported-post path. Creator identity is resolved from the post.

sponsorPageId.description: Shared Second Identity Facebook Page for uploaded media, or authorizing brand Page for imported Instagram posts. Per-campaign and active per-row values override this.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses an Instagram-only Second Identity, omitting its Facebook Page. Requires sponsorInstagramId. False or omitted for imported posts.

sponsorUseInstagramAccount.description: Legacy saved-build alias for sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount. Must be false or omitted for imported posts.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Optional shared Second Identity Instagram account for uploaded media, or brand Instagram account for imported posts.

displayMode.description: Launch-wide header mode: both (ad_format 1), first (2, creator-only for imported posts, labelled Partner identity only), or dynamic (3). Defaults to both.

sourceInstagramMediaId.description: Legacy shared-source assertion. Prefer mediaItems[].sourceInstagramMediaId; if supplied here, it must match the single imported row.

sourceFacebookPostId.description: Legacy field; a nonempty value is rejected for headless Facebook imports.

uploaderMode.description: True selects existing-post import and is rejected with uploaded media. Omit or set false for uploaded-media partnerships.

useFacebookPage.description: Use the Facebook Page as the Instagram identity for Pages with no linked Instagram account. Cannot be combined with instagramId.

campaigns.description: Per-campaign Page, Instagram, and Threads overrides keyed by campaign ID or unambiguous campaign name from campaign.campaigns.

useFacebookPage.description: Use the Facebook Page as the Instagram identity for Pages with no linked Instagram account. Cannot be combined with instagramId.

sponsorPageId.description: Second Identity Facebook Page ID. Omitted inherits. With sponsorInstagramId also null, removes the partner for this uploaded-media scope. Imported posts require an effective brand Page.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Second Identity Instagram account ID. Omitted inherits; null removes this ID. Both sponsor IDs null means No Partner for uploaded media.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses the Instagram account as Second Identity without a Facebook Page. Requires an effective sponsorInstagramId.

testMode.description: Admin-only. Assemble payloads and validate eligible calls through Meta validate_only without creating Meta objects. Returns metaValidation passed/failed/not-checked results; may store launch records and encrypted verified partnership codes.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

partnershipCreator.description: Optional expected creator identity, verified against Meta. It cannot replace the post owner or grant permission.

partnershipAdEligibility.description: Meta ad-eligibility verdict for the partnership post, used for the licensed-music warning. Null or UNKNOWN means Meta did not say.

sourceFacebookPostId.description: Legacy empty web field only. Facebook headless imports are not supported.

_id.description: Stable captured media identity, retained when resuming a saved build.

customName.description: Exact ad name. Nonblank values preserve spaces and literal tokens with NFC normalization only; blank clears the panel rename.

cta.description: Meta CTA enum, for example SHOP_NOW, or empty string. Human labels such as Shop Now are not normalized on the partnership path. Nonempty CTA requires an http(s) link.

callToAction.description: Meta CTA enum, for example SHOP_NOW, or empty string. Human labels such as Shop Now are not normalized on the partnership path. Nonempty CTA requires an http(s) link.

multiAdvertiserAds.description: Whether to allow multi-advertiser ads; defaults to true when omitted and not inherited.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

common.description: Shared imported-post text. Set shared sponsor fields in profile.partnership; put adCode in import or the active perAd/perAdset scope, never common.

tools.name: ads_get_job
tools.description: Get or resume an ad creation job by jobId, returning its summary and recent operations. After ads_create returns still_running, poll until complete is true.

operations.description: Use recent for the last 20 operations or full for the complete operation log.

tools.name: ads_duplicate_by_post
tools.description: Duplicate existing Meta ads selected by Page post ID into an existing ad set or new cloned ad set while preserving their post references. Use postIds for discovery or adIds for exact selection, never both. Preview returns sourceCandidates and a pinned resolvedRequest. Ambiguous matches require explicit adIds; warned live runs require acknowledgeWarnings:true or useCreativeId:true. This blocks until the duplication completes or the 30 minute ceiling is reached. If it returns status "still_running", call ads_get_duplication with the returned jobId until complete is true.

accountId.description: Meta ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

postIds.description: Discover source ads by Page post ID. Multiple matches require an explicit adIds selection; exclusive with adIds.

adIds.description: Ordered exact source ad IDs. Use preview.resolvedRequest to retain the reviewed selection; exclusive with postIds.

adSetId.description: Existing destination ad set, or the template when a new-ad-set mode is selected. Must belong to campaignId and the selected account.

newAdSet.description: One shared new ad set. Cannot be combined with newAdSetPerAd.

newAdSetPerAd.description: One new ad set per source ad. Cannot be combined with newAdSet; one source produces one shared clone.

adNamePattern.description: New ad name pattern. Supports {AdName} and {Index}.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Explicitly continue after reviewing preview creative warnings. Required for warned live runs unless useCreativeId is true.

useCreativeId.description: Reuse original creative IDs instead of creating post-reference creatives.

name.description: Name or name pattern. Ad set names support {AdName} and {Index}.

tools.name: ads_duplicate_by_post_preview
tools.description: Preview a post-ID duplication of existing Meta ads selected by Page post ID without creating anything. Use postIds for discovery or adIds for exact selection, never both. Preview returns sourceCandidates and a pinned resolvedRequest. Ambiguous matches require explicit adIds; warned live runs require acknowledgeWarnings:true or useCreativeId:true. Returns a cleaned source-to-destination plan and never exposes raw Meta payloads.

accountId.description: Meta ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

postIds.description: Discover source ads by Page post ID. Multiple matches require an explicit adIds selection; exclusive with adIds.

adIds.description: Ordered exact source ad IDs. Use preview.resolvedRequest to retain the reviewed selection; exclusive with postIds.

adSetId.description: Existing destination ad set, or the template when a new-ad-set mode is selected. Must belong to campaignId and the selected account.

newAdSet.description: One shared new ad set. Cannot be combined with newAdSetPerAd.

newAdSetPerAd.description: One new ad set per source ad. Cannot be combined with newAdSet; one source produces one shared clone.

adNamePattern.description: New ad name pattern. Supports {AdName} and {Index}.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Explicitly continue after reviewing preview creative warnings. Required for warned live runs unless useCreativeId is true.

useCreativeId.description: Reuse original creative IDs instead of creating post-reference creatives.

name.description: Name or name pattern. Ad set names support {AdName} and {Index}.

tools.name: ads_get_duplication
tools.description: Get or resume a duplication job by jobId. After ads_duplicate_by_post returns still_running, poll until complete is true.

tools.name: ads_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running ad creation job or media ingest job.

jobId.description: Ad creation job ID or media ingest job ID (ingest_...).
